next_step: Enable self-serve trial, provide batching/caching guide, follow-up 2025-11-25
company_description: SMB marketing/content-generation startup building a self-serve product for marketers to generate large batches of campaign copy and landing-page variants.
notes: Inbound from content-marketing tool lead-gen. Primary constraint: cost sensitivity at scale (expecting 20M-60M tokens/mo initially). Interested in hosted API (self-serve) — wants to avoid dedicated or VPC right now. Strong interest in batching + prefix/KV caching to lower unit costs. Quote from call: 'We need predictable per-campaign costs — can't have surprises.' Priorities: low latency for interactive editing (<=200ms median prefer), predictable monthly spend, easy billing card flow. Model preference: open/compatible models that can be quantized; happy to start on small cheaper variants for bulk generation then route to higher-quality models for live editing. Security: SOC2 baseline, basic audit logs; no need for on-prem/VPC in phase 1. Next: send simple cost projections and a short how-to on batching + cache patterns. AE notes: candidate for Optimize recommendations once volume stabilizes. Trial org created and keys issued 2025-11-06; running smoke tests against gpt-like open models.

use_case_and_requirements: High-throughput batch generation for marketing campaigns + lower-latency interactive editing. Targets: median latency <=200ms for editor workloads, bulk jobs can tolerate higher latency; budget-driven — target blended cost <$0.00012 per token. Wants clear guidance on batching sizes, cache TTLs, and model routing for cost vs quality tradeoffs.
poc_notes: POC plan: 1) Run 3 sample campaign jobs (1000 variants each) using hosted_api, compare cost across quantized open models; 2) Measure batching efficiencies at batch sizes 8/16/32; 3) Validate prefix caching for template reuse. Success criteria: cost estimates within 10% of projections and median editor latency <=200ms on small batches.
sales_play: Self-serve funnel. Offer additional trial credits tied to volume milestones. Provide case study of similar SMB that saved 30% with caching. Convert to paid hosted plan; revisit Optimize add-on after 3 months.
summary_line: Early-stage SMB (marketing automation) — inbound, cost-sensitive, interested in hosted API + batching/caching guidance; SOC2 baseline acceptable; likely to convert to low-mid ARR if pricing aligns.
